assessments.summary: Frequent but low-stakes cosmetic requests such as dark mode and file naming, raised by existing customers.
assessments.analytics_signal: Satisfaction scores among customers requesting cosmetic changes.
assessments.testable_question: Does shipping dark mode change retention or satisfaction without diverting roadmap capacity?

assessments.summary: Evaluators cannot tell what each plan includes or what they would pay, and some deals stall or are lost on it.
assessments.expected_behavior: High exits and low demo-CTA clicks on the pricing page, repeat pricing visits, pricing questions in chat.
assessments.funnel_stage: Evaluation, from pricing page to demo request
assessments.analytics_signal: Pricing-page exit rate and CTA rate by source, especially paid search; pricing page revisits per session.
assessments.testable_question: Does clearer package framing on the pricing page improve qualified demo requests without reducing lead quality?

assessments.summary: Requests for integrations, accuracy, and admin features that shape expansion more than acquisition.
assessments.analytics_signal: Feature usage and expansion rate for accounts requesting integrations or admin tools.
assessments.testable_question: Does an admin usage dashboard increase seat expansion without raising support load?

assessments.summary: Prospects hit broken or slow experiences, most acutely on the mobile demo form; customers also report integration and search defects.
assessments.expected_behavior: Mobile form starts without completion, rage clicks, slow load on the demo page.
assessments.analytics_signal: Mobile versus desktop demo-form completion, rage clicks, and page load time.
assessments.testable_question: Does fixing mobile demo-form performance increase completed demo requests without lowering lead quality?

assessments.summary: Many webinar-sourced contacts have no budget, authority, or active project; they are learning, not buying.
assessments.expected_behavior: Strong lead-to-MQL conversion but weak MQL-to-SQL acceptance for webinar leads.
assessments.funnel_stage: Consideration, at the MQL to SQL handoff
assessments.analytics_signal: Sales rejection reasons and MQL-to-SQL rate by source.
assessments.testable_question: Does adding buying-intent questions to webinar registration improve MQL-to-SQL conversion without cutting qualified attendance?

assessments.summary: Larger buyers need security and data-residency proof before they can sign.
assessments.expected_behavior: Late-stage deals stall; security-page visits from opportunity accounts.
assessments.funnel_stage: Purchase, during security and legal review
assessments.analytics_signal: Opportunity-to-win rate and cycle time for mid-market deals that request security documents.
assessments.testable_question: Does a self-serve trust center shorten mid-market deal cycles without adding sales effort?

assessments.summary: Buyers compare tools and tend to choose EchoAI on summary and action-item quality.
assessments.analytics_signal: Compare-page engagement and its conversion rate.
assessments.testable_question: Does leading with summary quality on the compare page improve win rate without slowing evaluation?

assessments.summary: Onboarding content is seen as helpful; little evidence of complexity problems.
assessments.analytics_signal: Activation rate for accounts that watch onboarding videos.
assessments.testable_question: Does surfacing onboarding videos earlier improve activation without adding friction?

assessments.summary: Setup steps such as SSO are unclear and slow onboarding.
assessments.analytics_signal: Time to first transcribed meeting by SSO status.
assessments.testable_question: Does a guided SSO setup shorten time-to-value without increasing support tickets?

assessments.summary: Some prospects are tied to existing contracts.
assessments.analytics_signal: Lead age at conversion for contract-locked prospects.
assessments.testable_question: Does a contract-renewal nurture track raise later conversion without increasing unsubscribes?

tensions: The most frequent request, cosmetic polish such as dark mode, comes from happy customers and does not block buying; the costliest problem, pricing clarity, is less frequent but blocks evaluators.
Webinars attract curious learners who rate the content highly, but those same contacts rarely have budget or authority to buy.
Evaluators want to self-serve pricing and demo booking, yet unclear plans and a broken mobile form push them into sales calls or away entirely.
Mid-market buyers praise product quality but cannot sign until security and data-residency proof is available.
research_gaps: We do not know which specific plan elements cause pricing confusion; run short pricing-page intercept surveys.
Evidence is not linked to lead or account records, so we cannot tie themes to pipeline value directly.
Mobile form complaints come from chat and support only; session recordings would confirm where the form fails.
Win and loss notes are sparse for mid-market deals, so the weight of trust and proof issues is uncertain.
